notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI implements the same event-raised, readiness-cleared model, explicitly patterned on Benilla (BENILLA_VS_MSUI_LOADING.md): the curtain arms at the Enter World click (ArmEnterWorldCurtain), per-map art resolves through the verified Map.dbc -> LoadingScreens.dbc -> BLP chain with a per-path decode cache, the bar draws the 1.12 two-layer Loading-BarBorder/Loading-BarFill art, progress is monotonic (BumpProgress), and the clear is gated on real residency: terrain ring, warmed+placed WMOs, near doodads drained behind the curtain, collision built under the player, appearance-ready avatar, then a pipeline-warm fade. Cross-map SMSG_NEW_WORLD re-arms the whole cycle via the world-entry transition stages.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: Bar rect fractions are MSUI's own LoadingScreen layout rather than Benilla's byte-verified {0.5,0.075,...} descriptor table; worth a screenshot A/B but likely close. Logout uses the glue transition rather than an explicit blackout frame - MSUI's single-threaded swap does not have Benilla's one-frame dead-world exposure.
